entries.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: portrait illustration background for a Japanese junior-high mathematics textbook cover in the Nobilog learning app. Make it exciting and polished, with a playful but sophisticated handcrafted 3D paper-cut world of geometry: colorful triangles, spheres, a curved number-line-like path with NO numbers, a small geometric bridge, floating polygon shapes and a welcoming miniature landscape. Rich blue and teal with warm coral accents, soft tactile shading, beautiful depth, very clear silhouettes even as a thumbnail. The upper third must be quiet dark blue negative space for a Japanese title which will be overlaid by code. Concentrate the interesting illustration in the bottom two thirds. Straight-on flat cover artwork, not a photograph of a book or a mockup. No text, letters, numbers, equations, logos, watermark or borders. Portrait aspect ratio near 600:848.
